content.json:
## IT Helpdesk health
Requests, failures, slow endpoints, exceptions and Kafka message handling for the five services.

content.title: Service summary
content.query:
requests
| where name !has 'process'
| summarize Requests = count(), Failed5xx = countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500), Rejected4xx = countif(toint(resultCode) between (400 .. 499)), AvgMs = round(avg(duration), 0), P95Ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0) by Service = cloud_RoleName
| order by Service asc

content.title: Requests over time
content.query:
requests
| where name !has 'process'
| summarize Requests = count() by bin(timestamp, 15m), Service = cloud_RoleName
| order by timestamp asc

content.title: Server errors (5xx) over time
content.query:
requests
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500
| summarize Errors = count() by bin(timestamp, 15m), Service = cloud_RoleName
| order by timestamp asc

content.title: Slowest endpoints (95th percentile, ms)
content.query:
requests
| where name !has 'process'
| summarize Calls = count(), AvgMs = round(avg(duration), 0), P95Ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0) by Service = cloud_RoleName, Endpoint = name
| where Calls >= 2
| top 15 by P95Ms desc

content.title: Kafka messages handled
content.query:
requests
| where name has 'process'
| summarize Handled = count(), Failed = countif(success == false), AvgMs = round(avg(duration), 0) by Service = cloud_RoleName, Topic = name
| order by Service asc, Topic asc

content.title: Most frequent exceptions
content.query:
exceptions
| where outerMessage !has 'Unknown topic or partition'
| summarize Count = count(), LastSeen = max(timestamp) by Service = cloud_RoleName, Type = type, Message = substring(outerMessage, 0, 120)
| top 15 by Count desc

content.title: Recent errors in the logs
content.query:
traces
| where severityLevel >= 3
| where message !has 'Unknown topic or partition'
| project timestamp, Service = cloud_RoleName, message = substring(message, 0, 200)
| top 20 by timestamp desc
